summary: Verified floating Feature Quota Pill end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 new contract tests + baseline 4/4 pill-related tests pass. Frontend: all 6 pill scenarios pass (normal state, limit-reached + upgrade nav, self-enforced hidden, premium hidden, dismiss + persist, regression smoke).
critical_code_review_comments: FeatureQuotaPill.tsx (72 lines): sound implementation. Uses ui_routes from session policy to auto-match current pathname, respects self_enforced flag, and honors localStorage per-feature-per-day dismissal. Live 429 hook via onFeatureQuotaLimit correctly flips to limit state instantly. No changes needed.

access_control.py route /api/access-control/feature-meter/{feature_key} correctly returns 404 for unknown keys, -1 for premium (unlimited), and computes remaining as max(0, limit-used). Uses db.feature_usage_meter.count_documents scoped to user_id + feature_key + day (UTC). Contract stable.
Minor: /features/ai-writer body_len at ~1333 chars looks light vs coaching-team (1862) - likely lazy-loaded content, but page renders without errors. Not a blocker.

Frontend is a static export (serve-production.js) — DO NOT restart the expo_manual supervisor; changes will not hot-reload.
